messages:
jen_prod: Hey team — new compact mock for the Usage landing: https://www.figma.com/file/new/billing-compact-rail (frame 'Landing - Burn Overlay'). Main Q: show "budget burn" as an overlay on token chart or as a separate microcard?

marco_design: Overlay looks nice visually, but can be noisy. Microcard might be clearer: 'Projected spend vs budget' with a small sparkbar + delta.

tay_eng: Overlay is cheap (SVG overlay), but needs clear legend and an accessible alternative. If overlay, add a high-contrast dashed line and SR table.

lena_billing: Ops: prefer microcard. Customers asked for explicit 'budget owner' and alert rules. Microcard can show owner and next invoice date.

rachel_a11y: a11y: overlay must not be the only indicator of budget breach. Add text label and aria-live alert when budget is exceeded. Ensure color contrast and non-color markers.

marco_design: alternative: show overlay on hover and microcard by default. Hover reveals burn line; microcard shows numeric forecast + time-to-burn.

ana_analytics: analytics: track toggle clicks (overlay vs microcard), budget_breach_toast_shown, and 'export_burn_csv'.

tay_eng: implementation notes: backend returns forecast and days-to-burn; frontend draws overlay from aggregated tokens-to-cost mapping. Lazy-load detailed forecast for orgs with >500 projects.

lena_billing: also: invoices remain org-level. If microcard has 'Export forecast', it should be clear it's org forecast. Non-billing users see 'Request forecast export'.

rachel_a11y: keyboard: make overlay toggle reachable via keyboard and expose the numeric forecast in a skip-link target. Use role="alert" for immediate breaches.

marco_design: will update mock: microcard + optional overlay on hover, visible legend, focusable toggle, high-contrast breach marker. Link: https://www.figma.com/file/new/billing-compact-rail?node-id=99%3A1

jen_prod: Great — actions: Marco update mocks (EOD), Tay spec lazy-load + aria hooks (PR next week), Lena confirm export wording, Rachel quick a11y smoke. Design review Friday 11:00 UTC. design-bot: reminder.

design-bot: Design review scheduled Friday 11:00 UTC. :spiral_calendar_pad: 

jen_prod: Closing unless blockers — keep height under 3 vertical folds on 1440w.
